author: Epic Games
description:
Ignite the flames of vengeance.

The brand-new version of Duet Night Abyss "Silver Torrent, Rising Star" is officially live! Log in now to claim your choice of a free character and weapon, plus up to 60 free pulls for the limited-time skin gacha. 

With all characters and weapons fully farmable, you have total freedom to fight your own way. As the Train to the Snowfield departs, an all-new story unfolds across Bloomfield Station and the Aurora Express—two new maps blending British style with steampunk. Finally, obtain brand-new characters Flora and Hilda, and unlock Flora’s angel-judgment skin "The Absolver," while the gorgeous Dusky Jazz, Bridal Elegance, and Sacred Prayer themed collections make their grand debut!

Play now for free. https://epic.gm/duetnightabyss
title: Duet Night Abyss | Flora Character Trailer | Summer Games Fest 2026

author: Epic Games
description:
The tides have turned, and this sea was never meant for those who play it safe. https://epic.gm/sea-of-remnants

Illusion Troupe - A sincere and joyful troupe at sea, and a home for the Shoreless.

Black Baron - Enjoying the romance and riches of the sea with elegance, dignity, and unwavering rules.

Dawnbreaker - Elites and brilliant misfits, all gathered under the banner of the Empress!

Wanderer - Sea drifters who go wherever they want and raise chaos wherever they land.

Ranbo - Orbtopia’s wildest rock stars!

Drift Bottle - Like a glass bottle cast into the waves, this ship never
questions where its passengers come from.

Captains, assemble your crew, raise the sails high, and make it loud to light up the night in the Sea of Remnants! Wishlist now.
title: Sea of Remnants | "Make it Loud" Crew PV | Summer Game Fest 2026
